name: SAR441255
review: Explicit first-in-human trial began 2019-04-25 in healthy/overweight participants. Molecule linkage is credible; type-2-diabetes programme intent needs separate evidence. Completed trial does not independently verify vendor abandonment.
review_scope: Initial registry linkage and identity/entry screening only; not complete programme-history adjudication.

name: RG7386
review: RO6874813 alias matches a phase-I solid-tumour trial starting 2015-10-11. Earlier worldwide entry and programme-level discontinuation remain unverified.
review_scope: Initial registry linkage and identity/entry screening only; not complete programme-history adjudication.

name: Ramorelix
review: No ClinicalTrials.gov hit on supplied name. Vendor abandonment retained as vendor evidence only. No entry date inferred from absence of a registry match.
review_scope: Initial registry linkage and identity/entry screening only; not complete programme-history adjudication.

name: Galantamine 1-Day Patch
review: Generic galantamine query retrieves 118 studies, truncated at 100. Oral galantamine and rivastigmine-patch studies are not NAL8801 history. Do not inherit oral-drug approval or trial dates for this patch.
review_scope: Initial registry linkage and identity/entry screening only; not complete programme-history adjudication.

name: LR19123
review: LC542019 alias matches a phase-I healthy/type-2-diabetes trial starting 2022-03-25. Earlier entry and whole-programme failure remain unverified.
review_scope: Initial registry linkage and identity/entry screening only; not complete programme-history adjudication.

name: DSP-0390
review: Vendor says abandoned-phase-I. Registry lists industry trial active-not-recruiting from 2021-09-08 and Washington University glioma study recruiting from 2025-04-03. Keep disagreement visible; neither a stale registry label nor sponsor abandonment settles global molecule-indication failure.
review_scope: Initial registry linkage and identity/entry screening only; not complete programme-history adjudication.

name: Wayrilz
review: Phase-II multi-drug trial began 2024-12-19 in FSGS/minimal-change disease. These are narrower than glomerulonephritis. Current rilzabrutinib arm presence does not prove that arm was present at the initial study start. Healthy-volunteer or pemphigus dates cannot substitute for renal-programme entry.
review_scope: Initial registry linkage and identity/entry screening only; not complete programme-history adjudication.

name: ION775
review: Only retrieved study is phase II starting 2026-05-12 in hypertriglyceridaemia. This is a later-era lead, not proof that development began in 2026; prior codes/phase-I history need verification.
review_scope: Initial registry linkage and identity/entry screening only; not complete programme-history adjudication.

name: HM97662
review: Molecule and solid-tumour phase-I trial match, start 2023-01-11. First worldwide entry and current programme ascertainment need corroboration.
review_scope: Initial registry linkage and identity/entry screening only; not complete programme-history adjudication.

name: CD117 CAR-T cell therapy
review: Descriptive CD117 CAR-T label yields no exact-name registry hit. Sponsor/product identity must precede broader target searches; do not merge all CD117 CAR-T products.
review_scope: Initial registry linkage and identity/entry screening only; not complete programme-history adjudication.

name: Ibtrozi
review: DS-6051b first-in-human solid-tumour trial started 2014-09. Broad trial condition alone does not establish when neuroendocrine patients entered. Later approval in another indication cannot become a neuroendocrine approval.
review_scope: Initial registry linkage and identity/entry screening only; not complete programme-history adjudication.

name: YHP2406
review: Two exact-code phase-I studies are bioequivalence studies beginning in 2025. Exclude these trials from novel-drug clinical-entry ascertainment; original programme/ingredient remains undisclosed.
review_scope: Initial registry linkage and identity/entry screening only; not complete programme-history adjudication.

name: Gynoxin
review: Returned fenticonazole studies test EVEGYN fixed combinations, not this Gynoxin product. Generic ingredient overlap is insufficient for product-history linkage.
review_scope: Initial registry linkage and identity/entry screening only; not complete programme-history adjudication.

name: Arasid
review: Topiramate epilepsy trials precede 2010 (one retrieved study starts 1988). Arasid is not automatically another molecule-indication sample. Current regional brand row cannot establish a new 2010-2024 programme.
review_scope: Initial registry linkage and identity/entry screening only; not complete programme-history adjudication.

name: Truxal
review: Search retrieves observational safety and later psychiatric studies. These do not establish first development in generalised anxiety or a US approval outcome.
review_scope: Initial registry linkage and identity/entry screening only; not complete programme-history adjudication.

name: Opisezol Codeine Liquid
review: No brand-specific registry hit. Vendor generic field is herbal extract although product name includes codeine. Composition and programme identity require verification.
review_scope: Initial registry linkage and identity/entry screening only; not complete programme-history adjudication.

name: Potentox
review: No hit for brand/fixed-combination query. Separate cefepime or amikacin programmes cannot be used as this combination history.
review_scope: Initial registry linkage and identity/entry screening only; not complete programme-history adjudication.

name: Enwylma
review: EMA medicine-overview search result identifies Enwylma as biosimilar to Xgeva. Generic denosumab search is truncated and includes originator programmes. Verify biosimilar development separately; exclude from novel/unapproved-at-entry CMP sensitivity.
review_scope: Initial registry linkage and identity/entry screening only; not complete programme-history adjudication.

name: INFeD
review: Vendor indication approval date is 1974-04-29, predating the 2010 entry window. FDA date needs regulator reconciliation before final exclusion; modern iron-dextran studies do not establish new inception.
review_scope: Initial registry linkage and identity/entry screening only; not complete programme-history adjudication.

name: Wayrilz
review: FDA confirms rilzabrutinib approval for persistent/chronic ITP in 2025. Retrieved ITP trial starts 2018-03-22 in phase II. Do not place it in a phase-I-entry denominator using 2016 pemphigus history. FDA approval is not in dispute; entry-stage attribution still matters.
review_scope: Initial registry linkage and identity/entry screening only; not complete programme-history adjudication.

name: Dopamine Hydrochloride
review: Vendor indication approval dates are 1987-03-27 and 1987-11-02. Preserve both; regulator/application reconciliation needed. Broad dopamine query returns many unrelated interventions and indications.
review_scope: Initial registry linkage and identity/entry screening only; not complete programme-history adjudication.

name: Ditemer
review: Vendor date is 1997-06-30. Vaccine/formulation identity and exact indication need checking; modern booster trials must not reset entry.
review_scope: Initial registry linkage and identity/entry screening only; not complete programme-history adjudication.

name: Vogelxo
review: Vendor approval is 2014-06-04, but that does not prove 2010-2024 first clinical entry. Broad testosterone search retrieves 1,039 studies and is truncated. Need USL240-specific history and reformulation/prior-approval flags.
review_scope: Initial registry linkage and identity/entry screening only; not complete programme-history adjudication.

name: Aquasol
review: Vendor indication approval date is 1949-05-18. Broad vitamin-A search is not brand-specific history. Regulator verification and canonical molecule mapping needed before final exclusion.
review_scope: Initial registry linkage and identity/entry screening only; not complete programme-history adjudication.
